title: Matrix house explorer
description: Drag two arrows and watch a house move. Column 1 of a 2×2 matrix is where (1, 0) goes; column 2 is where (0, 1) goes.

title: Mean, median, mode and spread
description: Drag dots on a number line and watch the mean, median, mode, range and standard deviation change. Type a list, use a frequency table, or pick a ready-made data set.
